name: Parent Notification of Restraint Use
description: Notice to parents of the use of restraints, followed by an IEP team meeting within 10 school days unless waived.
preparedBy: Director of Special Education or designee
quote: The Director of Special Education or designee shall notify the parent/guardian as soon as practicable of the use of restraints to control the aggressive behavior of the student and shall convene a meeting of the IEP team within ten (10) school days of the use of restraints, unless the parent/guardian, after written notice, agrees in writing to waive the meeting.
